# Bot PRs still red PR body: neo calls the shared baseline at v0.1.17

## Context

`neo-agent-skills` 0.1.19 (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#118, resolving neomjs/neo-agent-skills#117) stops judging a bot author's close target. neo's caller still calls `@v0.1.17`. So dependabot's `#19199` fails `PR body` even after a rebase: run 36122657042 used `reusable-pr-baseline.yml@refs/tags/v0.1.17` and printed "PR body has no valid close target".

## The Problem

A bot's PR can't carry `Resolves #N`. Until the caller moves, every dependabot PR in neo reds `PR body`, and the operator is merging them now.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml:68` calls `neomjs/neo-agent-skills/.github/workflows/reusable-pr-baseline.yml@v0.1.17`.
- Between `v0.1.17` and `v0.1.19`, the called workflow adds no input and no permission. Its tag check, new in 0.1.18, requires the caller at exactly `@v0.1.19`: the workflow ref must end in `@refs/tags/v0.1.19`.
- A `pull_request` run takes the caller from the merge ref. Once `dev` has the move, rebasing `#19199` picks it up.

## The Fix

On line 68, change `@v0.1.17` to `@v0.1.19`. Nothing else changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The caller is at `@v0.1.19`, and the PR's own baseline run is green, including `PR body`.
- [ ] Post-merge, flagged: `#19199`, rebased, passes `PR body`.

## Out of Scope

- The Institution and devindex callers stay with dependabot. Its move of an `@v` reference is neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114's AC-4 live test, and moving them by hand would pre-empt it. neo moves by hand because its dependabot PR is waiting for merge.
- The `neo-agent-skills` npm pin in `package.json`, which is exact-pinned by design and moves separately.

## Related

neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114 (consumers call the shared baseline by version) · #19197 (the move to `v0.1.17`)
